Base UI turns this file into `prehydrationScript.min.ts` with a minifier. Vase UI copies the resulting script text into its prehydration module, with the edits that its comment names. Its components use that module.

`Tabs.test.ts` tests the value, the first value, the changes of the root with each reason, the activation, the keys, the tab stop, the names, the panels, the direction, nested roots and Tabs in popups, with the native elements of the parts.
`Tabs.test.ts` tests the role and the name of the list, the keys with and without `loopFocus`, the keys to a disabled tab and past a tab that the browser disables, and the tab stop after a removal.

exceptions.title: does not set tabIndex=0 on disabled tabs when they are programmatically selected
exceptions.reason: The active tab has the tab stop, also a disabled one; with no active tab, the first tab has it (WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices, keyboard interface of tabs). Base UI moves the tab stop off a disabled or a missing tab.

exceptions.title: keeps tracking a successor through subsequent removals
exceptions.reason: The active tab has the tab stop, also a disabled one; with no active tab, the first tab has it (WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices, keyboard interface of tabs). Base UI moves the tab stop off a disabled or a missing tab.

exceptions.title: when `activateOnFocus = true` should call onValueChange on pointerdown
exceptions.reason: A tab activates at `click` and in the key handler of the list, not at the focus event. The browsers then agree: Safari gives a pressed button no focus. A press of a secondary button sends no `click`, so it activates nothing with no guard.

exceptions.title: calls onValueChange with the selected value when the implicit default matches a later tab
exceptions.reason: With no `defaultValue`, the first tab that is not disabled is active, as the first option of a native `<select>`. The server HTML then has the active tab and its panel. Base UI starts on the tab of value `0`.

exceptions.title: cleans and replaces panel registrations in Strict Mode
exceptions.reason: Vue has no Strict Mode. The case of `Tabs.test.ts` replaces, removes and mounts the panel again with the same steps.

exceptions.title: renders as an anchor and toggles selection when `nativeButton` is false
exceptions.reason: The tab reads the element that it renders, so it has no `nativeButton`. A link in the `element` slot activates with a press, Enter and Space.

exceptions.title: renders a react-router Link
exceptions.reason: The case renders a component of React Router. `as` and the `element` slot render each element or component: `test/as.test.ts` renders `RouterLink` of vue-router, and the case of a link covers the press.

exceptions.title: settles when the rendered component recreates its merged ref
exceptions.reason: The case tests a merged React ref. Vue gives the element through `elementRef` of the `element` slot.

exceptions.title: sets the panel index data attribute
exceptions.reason: `data-index` is cut. It counts only the panels in the DOM. The developer has the index where they render the panels, `:nth-child()` selects by place, and `data-activation-direction` gives the side for a slide.

exceptions.title: triggers enter animation via data-starting-style when mounting
exceptions.reason: `<Transition>` around `Tabs.Panel` gives the enter and leave classes. The panel has no `data-starting-style` and no `data-ending-style`.

exceptions.title: applies data-ending-style before unmount
exceptions.reason: `<Transition>` around `Tabs.Panel` gives the enter and leave classes. The panel has no `data-starting-style` and no `data-ending-style`.

exceptions.title: renders a panel that suspends when opened with the boundary outside the root
exceptions.reason: React hides the mounted tree and shows the fallback when a panel suspends after the mount. Vue keeps a resolved Suspense branch when the same root component mounts an async descendant.
